answer: Before an identity may answer, it must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to the epoch seed and its own key, taking about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 660 fakes pays 440 CPU-minutes every epoch plus power, while one honest agent pays once, so cloning stops scaling. The relic of the design is public, the quartz of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the plume of honest work is what finally pays.
